reason: TRANSFER/LEAKAGE lens. (1) The part of the idea that would transfer is worth nothing. The GT-free geometric change (velocity carry, gates scaled by sqrt(k+1)) was measured by the research itself at +1 TP / 0 FP after the edge filter. Without the filter it was net negative (+31 TP / +58 FP). Everything that remains ('ILP-first / FILL on post-freeze transitions') gains only by trusting the edge network over the relink. That network was trained on all 199 train videos, and its labels are exactly the evaluable edges. (2) That channel has now failed on the LB three times: relink-off (probe 21) went from local positive to LB -0.002 (0.945); relink bonus 2.5 gave 0.945; drop-only edge filter ef_a0 (probe 30) went from lab SELECTION +0.0095 to LB 0.946 (-0.001 vs exp39). Probe 29 (the full filter) is pending but likely to fail too. The refined idea's local +0.0010..0.0013 is measured ON TOP OF ef, a base that does not transfer, and its pre-ef sim number (+190 TP / -229 FP on post frames) is the same channel with a bigger in-sample dose. (3) Direct memorization signature in edges_exp39.parquet (6bba, ILP-scored edges, same pre-linefit length). Mean edge_prob on free (unannotated) edges vs evaluable (annotated = training-label) edges. Normal transitions: [0,2) um .873/.922, [2,4) .863/.910, [4,7) .831/.884, [7,20) .777/.874. POST-FREEZE transitions: .855/.912, .824/.894, .781/.875, .762/.883. On annotated cells the net's confidence stays flat as the step grows. On free cells it decays. The gap is widest on post-freeze long steps (+0.121). Share with p > 0.97: 9.9% of post free edges vs 33.7% of post TP. (4) Where the ILP 'beats' the relink on post-freeze frames: of 87 relink FP whose ILP alternative is evaluable, 84 have a TP alternative and only 3 an FP. Those correct ILP links are LONG (median 9.03 um, p90 13.2 um; normal frames 7.6 um), comparable to the sister separation of 9-10 um, yet they carry mean p 0.881 (57% above 0.9), against 0.762 for free post edges of 7-20 um. A 97% win rate on 9-um jumps in a dense field is what memorised training links look like, not a generalising linker. On an unseen embryo the net behaves like the 'free' column: its confidence decays on exactly these doubled-motion steps, so ILP-first has no edge over the relink there. The research's own 'ILP advantage is 10x larger on post frames' is best explained by this: the in-sample advantage is largest where the task is hardest. (5) 44b6 bit-identical is a built-in control only for 'no harm on freeze-free embryos'. It says nothing about transfer. SELECTION and CONFIRMATION 6bba are time windows of ONE recording with a shared freeze clock (pattern shifted +22 frames between crops), so 'both halves positive' is not an independent replication. (6) Node multiplier: not the source. FILL/ILPONLY change edges, not nodes, so the gain is not a node-count artefact. It is, however, a pure edge-network-trust artefact.
fix_if_any: Only three repairs survive this lens. (a) Make it strictly conditional on probe 29. If exp49 (full edge filter with ILP re-link) scores >= 0.950, the ILP-trust channel does transfer on the test embryo, and ILP-first on post-freeze transitions can ride as a zero-cost bundle item (np.array_equal freeze detection, ILPONLY preferred because it removes FP; 44b6 bit-identical). If probe 29 scores <= 0.948, close the idea. (b) Test it with an honest linker: rerun the post-freeze sim with an edge net trained leave-embryo-out (6bba held out), or at least with the learned-p term zeroed and the ILP rebuilt from geometry only. If the post-freeze ILP advantage over the relink falls to the normal-frame level (+0.2%), the gain was memorization. (c) Lab readout stratified by the length of the seeded ILP edge. Reject if more than half of the net gain comes from ILP links above 5 um, the range where free-vs-annotated confidence diverges most (memorization gap 0.09-0.12). A GT-free variant worth testing instead: scale only the RELAXED gate on post-freeze t by sqrt(k+1), and only for nodes left unmatched after the tight pass, so it uses no network trust. But the research already measured gate scaling as neutral-to-negative, so expect ~0.
realistic_public_gain: About 0 (range -0.001 to +0.0005). The GT-free parts measure ~0 locally. The network-trust part copies the relink-off and ef_a0 patterns, which lost 0.001-0.002 on the LB, and it is further multiplied by P(hidden embryo has duplicate frames) ~0.5. It cannot be measured at LB resolution (0.001), and it does not move the needle toward 0.97.
